messages:
mira: heads-up — rolling the vpc egress split policy to prod us-west-2 in ~10m. this adds per-subnet deny rules and a secondary nat path for ephemeral pools. might hit onboarding for gpu warm pools. :eyes:
raj: noted. is this the same policy that flips snat to the new nat region pool?
mira: yep, primary -> regional natgw, fallback -> burst-nat. expected improvement for long-tail traffic, but conntrack could spike.
carol: conntrack + gpu warmup = ⚠️ we've seen node onboarding stall when conntrack table fills. last time we fixed with sysctl bump + nat scaling.
ben: timeline? can we gate on warm-pool healthcheck passing before policy becomes active for those subnets?
elia: we have a short healthcheck window today (5m). i'd prefer a canary for one AZ first. otherwise we'll see provisioning lag and tokenized jobs queue up.
mira: canary sounds good. i'll target az-a only. ops-bot: deploy plan started: PR https://github.internal/r/redwood/infra/merge/1553 :truck:
ops-bot: running preflight: checking natgw autoscale, conntrack quota, route table propagation... preflight found high auditlog QPS for control-plane on this account. security-bot: audit logging increase expected due to rule evals — projected +45% CloudWatch ingestion.
raj: that will bump costs and SLOs for log delivery. is the extra audit granularity adjustable?
security-bot: we can reduce match logging for ephemeral-sg flows. propose turning off per-packet rule logging and keep flow-sampled logs.
carol: immediate mitigation if onboarding stalls: 1) rollback policy 2) increase node conntrack: 
```
sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144
sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established=86400
```
3) ensure natgw target tracking + scale up by +2
ben: also add temporary KMS retry backoff for onboarding agent — we saw decrypt bursts lead to HSM proxy queuing under audit storms. set env: `KMS_RETRY_BASE=200` `KMS_RETRY_MAX=2000`
elia: creating runbook snippet + pager: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/vpc-egress-split — will add a canary checklist and rollback steps.
mira: executing az-a canary now. watch: /alerts/warm-pool-queue and /dashboards/warmup-latency. please react with :thumbsup: when you see steady state.
raj: seeing small conntrack bump, natgw healthy. audit ingesters show +30% but within budget for canary.
carol: warm-pool nodes in az-a passed onboarding, no KMS errors. leaving canary running for 15m.
ben: if it looks stable after 15m, schedule az-b next. otherwise rollback.
mira: agreed. post-mortem note: add a policy toggle to disable per-subnet logging during evanescent provisioning windows. filing issue: infra#2987.
security-bot: flagged for compliance review — will validate reduced logging still meets audit retention and e-discovery SLOs.
elia: thanks all — will follow up with cost delta + exact CloudWatch bytes next hour.
ops-bot: canary end: 36m later. status: success -> promoting to az-b gradually. final: no rollback required.
